name: XCC_ACCOUNT_GROUP_DETAILS
description: This table stores the individual budget accounts that comprise each account group.  This enables easy monitoring of funds available balances by the accounts in each group.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each budget account in the account group.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ALIAS
columns.description: Alternate name for budget account detail.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the account group associated with this detail

columns.name: THRESHOLD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Determines whether to always display this budget account or to only display it if the funds available exceeds a threshold based on absolute amount or percentage of budget.

columns.name: THRESHOLD_VALUE
columns.description: For budget accounts that are only displayed if the balance exceeds a threshold, this is the numeric value of that threshold.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the control budget associated with this budget account.

columns.name: SEGMENT1_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: The 1st segment of the budget account.  The setup of the control budget determines which segments are used.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
